headline: Bell Canada Reports Data Theft Following 'Agentic' Cybersecurity Breach
summary: Bell Canada confirmed that enterprise customer data was stolen during an agentic cybersecurity incident, noting that no highly sensitive private data was compromised.
why: BCE Inc. (Bell Canada) is Canada's largest telecommunications conglomerate, providing network services to corporations and government departments.

impacts.name: BCE Inc.
impacts.why: Cybersecurity breaches can result in regulatory scrutiny and customer remediation expenses.
